title: Recover the circuits of a four-element matroid from its bases

source.citation: Daniel Corey, Lukas Kuhne, and Benjamin Schroter, Matroids in OSCAR, arXiv:2311.08792

translation.notes: The five displayed bases are entered independently. Noether reconstructs the matroid, its ranks and exactly the three source circuits. The paper's realization-space calculations remain a separate blocked-feature record.
